entries.title: A follow-up about another project's files lands in that project
entries.body: A follow-up about another project's files now files its task in that project, so the fix is committed and merged where those files live. Preparing a change the task does not have now says the change was committed in another project's folder. It says the task has to move there first, instead of asking for a commit that would not help.
entries.noPicture: Which project a filed task lands in and one refusal's words change; the task board shows the row only once a crewmate files one.
